prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original character concept for Kindred Siege, Glutton v3, for owner review, not a sprite.
Make ONE coherent full-body character presentation with a small matching expression study. This is a NEW design from the following brief, no existing character likeness should be reproduced.

PRIMARY CHARACTER: an enormous swollen dark astral patriarch with a strong carefree FUNNY UNCLE personality. Patient, mischievous, affectionate toward his comrades, completely unbothered by his own corruption. The player should instantly think "terrifyingly powerful alien uncle who will tease me and then lovingly fix my broken armour". Not a solemn death priest, sneering villain, pitiful sick creature or cute comedy mascot. His humour must be visible in the performance, not explained by labels. He is an ancient trusted camp companion, responsible for ARMOUR AND BODY AUGMENTS.

SILHOUETTE RESET:
Show him STANDING at three-quarter front with his weight comfortably on one leg, relaxed and expansively confident. Enormous swollen body with broad clearly articulated shoulders, a substantial chest, great round abdomen resting above the wrap, strong thick forearms, two separate supporting legs. A convincing heavy body with structural landmarks and generous mass; not a bodybuilder, not a shapeless teardrop or a sagging seated blob. Keep neck and head clearly legible above the shoulder line. Full figure including feet visible. Head large enough to carry personality at a glance, but not chibi. Anatomical exaggeration is in mass and alien transformation, not toy proportions.

FACE AND PERFORMANCE:
Almost completely alien astral anatomy, not a fat human dressed as a wizard. A broad, powerful cranial structure with angular swept cheek shelves and a low layered brow ridge, two dark deep-set lateral eyes, no human external ears and no protruding human nose. The surface is beautiful living nacre, not a skull helmet. He has weathered laugh creases where the alien facial plates articulate, asymmetric lifted brow, warmly amused intelligent gaze, a relaxed broad sideways smile that does not show a maw or sharp rows of teeth. Tilt his head with the patient confidence of an uncle who has heard your excuse before. One open hand makes an easy conversational "come here, let me see it" gesture. His other hand casually carries a small repaired obsidian armour plate, as if skilled work is effortless. No combat stance. A small matching portrait at upper right shows the same face breaking into a hearty, good-natured chuckle; laughter belongs to an ancient alien, no clown mugging, exaggerated human teeth or jolly Santa face.

MATERIALS AND COLOUR:
Underlying skin is luminous-by-reflection mother-of-pearl biological material, SHARED ORIGIN but entirely different anatomy and palette from the leader. Rich dark aubergine, smoked violet and muted plum with pale lavender nacre highlights across broad continuous skin surfaces. Keep these colours distinct from brown-grey mud. No emissive skin, neon, rainbow oil slick, starfield texture, galaxy-print skin or luminous circuitry. Beautiful beneath corruption, tactile and alive.
Organically integrated obsidian load-bearing ribs and subtle ancient gold implant joins suggest an ascended cybernetic biological people. Visible skin across upper torso, abdomen, forearms and head. No six-pack, no exposed groin, no artificial muscle suit.
The owner wants both hidden corruption and overt grotesque rot: delicate charcoal branching under beautiful intact skin, and ONE clearly localized decaying seam under a flank armour plate with eroded layered nacre edges, a little dark fibrous tissue and restrained pearl regrowth. Do not scatter pustules, slime, ulcers or boils all over him. No blood, exposed organs or body horror close-up. His whole identity must not become a diseased texture.

CLOTHING AND AUGMENTATION:
True obsidian-black ceremonial cloth with dark purple only inside folds, original cult regalia. A wide low asymmetric shoulder mantle drapes down his back; it does not swallow his head. Sculpted polished volcanic-glass plates follow the weight of his shoulders and flank in a few big readable shapes. A heavy carefully wrapped lower garment below the abdomen has long vertical folds and a divided front allowing the legs to read. Restrained worn ancient-gold fastenings and a small broken cult seal. Grown body augments and exposed skin remain visible. Roughly half skin visible as a loose compositional balance. Not a generic blacksmith apron, sack, bathrobe, priest cassock, bulky knight suit or copied leader outfit.
All limbs shown for this provisional anatomy study; do not select or canonise a specific amputation, prosthetic injury or survival backstory.
Restrained charcoal mist leaks from the flank seam and mantle edge, following a couple of quiet purposeful curls around his hands and feet. Thin enough not to hide silhouette, no giant supernatural cloud.

HARD EXCLUSIONS:
No transparent brain, forehead/third eye, dreadlocks, beard, crown, halo, giant pointed head or split-arch headgear: these are leader-exclusive. No stock green plague demon, belly mouth, horns, antlers, tentacles, fly symbols, copied Warhammer character, tusks, weapon, food gag, beer mug, cauldron or piles of workshop clutter. No celebrity or known character likeness. Do not remake an oval-headed hunched grey slug in black rags.

PRESENTATION:
Exceptional art-directed dark fantasy science-fiction game character painting with controlled stylization, refined shape design and tactile materials. The warm personality and black humour must coexist with the ancient imposing alien appearance. Crisp readable silhouette and broad controlled values, not over-rendered noise. Single main full figure occupies about 75 percent of a landscape sheet, small face expression study upper right, uncluttered warm grey studio background lighter than his black garments. Soft neutral key light reveals deep violet pearlescence; very restrained gold bounce, no theatrical horror underlighting. No scenery or other characters. Small understated heading "GLUTTON" with subheading "ARMOUR / BODY AUGMENTS". No explanatory prose or fake gameplay UI.
inspectionAtGenerationBeforeOwnerApprova: Viewed generated full sheet. No leader-exclusive clear brain/three-eye arrangement/dreads/crown. Limitations: flank decay still conspicuous; more plated and solid than ethereal; neither gameplay-scale readability nor intentional mist motion is established. Owner visual approval is pending.
